parameters.subject: =How was your coaching session today?
parameters.html:
=

Your Feedback Matters

Hello {{$node["Code - Prepare Feedback Request"].json["firstName"]}},

Thank you for your coaching session today. I hope you found it valuable and insightful.

Your feedback is incredibly important to me as it helps me improve and tailor our future sessions to better meet your needs.

Session Details:

Date & Time: {{$node["Code - Prepare Feedback Request"].json["sessionDateTime"]}}

Duration: {{$node["Code - Prepare Feedback Request"].json["sessionDuration"]}}

Would you please take a moment to share your thoughts about our session? It will only take about 2 minutes.

Provide Feedback

Your insights will help me continue to provide the best coaching experience possible.

Thank you for your time and partnership in your growth journey.

Best regards,
Your Coach

If the button above doesn't work, you can copy and paste this link into your browser: {{$node["Code - Prepare Feedback Request"].json["feedbackFormUrl"]}}

parameters.subject: =Reminder: We'd love your feedback on your recent coaching session
parameters.html:
=

Your Feedback is Important

Hello {{$node["Code - Prepare Reminder"].json["firstName"]}},

I hope you're doing well! I'm following up about your coaching session on {{$node["Code - Prepare Reminder"].json["sessionDate"]}}.

We haven't received your feedback yet, and your insights would be incredibly valuable in helping me improve our coaching sessions.

Provide Feedback

It will only take about 2 minutes to complete, and your honest feedback will help me tailor our future sessions to better meet your needs.

Thank you for your time and partnership in your growth journey.

Best regards,
Your Coach

If the button above doesn't work, you can copy and paste this link into your browser: https://forms.example.com/feedback?id={{$node["Code - Prepare Reminder"].json["feedback_id"]}}
